data.long_meaning: In the Hebrew language, Hosaria is derived from the Hebrew word ‘hoshea’ meaning ‘salvation’ or ‘savior.’ This name is a female form of Hosea, which is a name given to a prophet in the Old Testament who was called by God to save his people from sin.
